subject: Q1 hiring proposal: SE + CS scaling, comp bands and offer routing
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Q1 hiring proposal: SE + CS scaling, comp bands and offer routing

Hi Laura and Marissa —

Quick summary: attached is a proposed Q1 hiring plan to grow our GTM engineering coverage (Solutions Eng + Customer Success). High-level ask: approval to open 9 roles across SE and CS, permission to extend offers up to the mid OTE of the proposed comp bands, and approval of the routing/approvals flow so recruiters can start outreach.

Why now:
- Pipeline is up 42% q/q in enterprise and our current SE span is at 1:16, which is impacting demo capacity and post-sale onboarding SLAs.
- We have three stewarded renewals in Jan that will require additional post-sales kit.

Proposed hires (headcount):
- 5 Senior Solutions Engineers (US West / hybrid)
- 3 Customer Success Managers (Mid-Market)
- 1 Solutions Engineering Manager (West) — to lead the new hires

Comp bands and offer guidance (attached PDF):
- SE Sr: OTE $220k - $280k (base 55-65% + commission eligible for pre-sales credits)
- CSM: OTE $140k - $180k
- SEM: OTE $280k - $340k

Budget ask and timing:
- Total incremental run-rate: ~$2.1M annualized including burdened benefits (see sheet). Requesting approval to commit to offers for 5 roles in December and stagger the rest in Jan.

Routing/approvals flow I propose:
1) Recruiter extends verbal offer (up to band midpoint)
2) Hiring manager approves escalation to midpoint+ with written justification
3) Finance sign-off required for any offer above midpoint+10%
4) Final sign-off: Laura for headcount, Marissa for compensation exceptions

Attachments: Q1_2027_SE_CS_headcount.xlsx, compensation_bands_Q1_2027.pdf, sample_offer_letter_SE.docx

Next steps: Can I get a quick thumbs-up on headcount and the flow so we can brief recruiters? If you want, I can break down by region and total cash impact per quarter.

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Q1 hiring proposal: SE + CS scaling, comp bands and offer routing

Thanks for the summary, Karthik. I appreciate the urgency. A few clarifying asks before I sign off:
- Break the 9 roles into Q4 dec/Jan buckets with expected start dates.
- Show the cashflow impact per quarter (not just annual run-rate).
- For offers above midpoint, include a short justification template (3 lines) so Marissa and I can approve quickly.

If you can get that to me by EOD Thursday I can give a provisional OK.

Laura
Head of GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Q1 hiring proposal: SE + CS scaling, comp bands and offer routing

Laura —
Attaching an updated sheet that splits hires into Dec/Jan and includes quarterly cashflow. See the short justification template at the top of tab "Approvals". Key changes:
- December: 3 SE Sr (recruited earlier), 1 SEM (internal transfer), 1 CSM (urgent renewal support)
- January: remaining 4 SE Sr + 2 CSM

Justification template excerpt: "Business need: coverage gap / expected ARR influence / time-to-value" — hiring manager to provide one-liner + candidate scarcity note.

Attachments: Q1_2027_SE_CS_headcount.xlsx, compensation_bands_Q1_2027.pdf

Let me know if this is enough to provisionally approve offers to recruiters (not final sign-off for >midpoint).

Karthik
(On behalf of Recruiting too; Rachel Stone is queued to start outreach once we get the green light.)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-19T09:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Q1 hiring proposal: SE + CS scaling, comp bands and offer routing

Thanks Karthik — I like the phased approach. Approve headcount as laid out. A couple of notes from a compensation and quota perspective:
- Approve offers up to midpoint for all roles. Any offer that needs to go above midpoint requires: candidate comp comp (current OTE), 2 internal comps, and hiring manager rationale. Send those to me and Laura as a quick email with subject line: "Comp Exception: <candidate last name> - <role>".
- For SEs: be careful with draw vs commission structure; the recruiter should only present OTE and base in initial outreach to avoid over-promising quota splits.
- Please route all final offer letters to People Ops (fwd to recruiting@external-peopleops.com) for standardization before sending.

Cc'ing Vivek for budget verification on the exceptions above. Once Vivek confirms budget runway, recruiting can start verbal offers up to midpoint.

Marissa
VP Sales

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-19T11:31:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Q1 hiring proposal: SE + CS scaling, comp bands and offer routing

Approved from finance perspective with the following constraints:
1) We have budgeted an additional $1.95M run-rate for GTM hiring in Q1; the plan as submitted (~$2.1M) puts us slightly over until we account for timing (some hires start in Feb). If we keep the December cohort to 3 hires, run-rate stays within tolerance.
2) Any offer > midpoint+10% needs a line-item in the hiring sheet showing offset (e.g., lower contractor spend or deferred hiring elsewhere).
3) Backfill policy: if any of these are backfills for a role vacated in the last 6 months, mark them as backfill and route through People Ops for headcount reclaim.

I've added comments in the Google Sheet (linked). Once you consolidate any exception justifications, I will sign off on individual offers.

Vivek
Head of Finance Operations

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Q1 hiring proposal: SE + CS scaling, comp bands and offer routing

All — good work on the deck and the split. I am signing off provisionally:
- Headcount: APPROVED as phased (3 in Dec, rest in Jan)
- Offers: recruiters can extend verbal offers up to midpoint immediately.
- Exceptions: follow Marissa's exception email pattern; include Vivek's offset note in the sheet.

Action items:
- Karthik: Share final hiring packet with Rachel and People Ops (recruiting@external-peopleops.com) and confirm start dates by EOD Monday.
- Marissa: I'll send you the signed memo for tracking.
- Vivek: Once exceptions show offsets in the sheet, please confirm so we can issue written offers.

Thanks — moving to execution.

Laura
Head of GTM Operations
